meta: Generated 2026-04-26 · RDKit 2026.03.1 · BaseFeatures.fdef · interaction-filtered · Kabsch consensus · 12 cryo-EM holostructures
summary_html:
Twelve CXCR4 cryo-EM holostructures (2.7–3.4 Å) were analyzed to derive a validated structure-based pharmacophore for prospective virtual screening. The orthosteric pocket presents a Donor + PosIonizable–dominated pharmacophore anchored on a conserved acidic pair: ASP270 (TM6) and GLU296 (TM7), which together absorb 33 of the 39 retained features across the orthosteric set.

The pharmacophore is preserved across a 7.2 Å Cα conformational shift (8U4P vs 8ZPN, both VH6) and converges across two distinct chemotypes — VH6 (Plerixafor / AMD3100) and A1D (Mavorixafor) — within ~3 Å mean feature distance. Cholesterol (CLR, 16 copies) and a co-bound lipid (D21) are rejected by the interaction filter (<8% retention) and serve as built-in negative controls.

Deliverable: a 22-feature consensus query (11 mandatory, 11 optional), Donor + PosIonizable only, directly importable into Pharmer / align-it / RDKit shape screening (consensus_pharmacophore.json).

strategies.name: Strict
strategies.behavior: High precision, low recall. Demands a ligand that recapitulates the orthosteric pharmacophore exactly.

strategies.name: Relaxed
strategies.behavior: Balanced precision / recall. Accommodates chemotype diversity while preserving the core Donor + PosIonizable fingerprint.

strategies.name: Scoring
strategies.behavior: Tunable via threshold. Ranks hits continuously rather than pass/fail.

interaction_map:
TM6   ASP270  (= ASP262 in 8U4P)  ←  [Donor ×8]  [PosIonizable ×12]   ALL 3 entries — PRIMARY anchor
TM7   GLU296  (= GLU288 in 8U4P)  ←  [Donor ×5]  [PosIonizable ×8]    ALL 3 entries
ECL2  ASP187                      ←  [Donor ×1]  [PosIonizable ×2]    A1D (8ZPL) + VH6 (8ZPN)
TM2   ASP97                       ←  [Donor]     [PosIonizable]        A1D (8ZPL) only
ECL2  GLN200                      ←  [Acceptor]                        A1D (8ZPL) — sole Acceptor partner
interaction_map_note: Every retained Donor / PosIonizable feature is anchored on the TM6+TM7 acidic pair. ASP187 (ECL2) is engaged by A1D and by VH6 in 8ZPN but not by VH6 in the 8U4P activation state — consistent with the 7.2 Å Cα shift swinging ECL2 in/out of range. Prioritize hits satisfying the TM6+TM7 pair; ECL2 engagement is an optional bonus.
caveat: Numbering offset. 8U4P is numbered with an 8-residue offset relative to 8ZPL and 8ZPN: ASP262 ≡ ASP270 and GLU288 ≡ GLU296 are the same conserved TM6/TM7 acidic anchors (Ballesteros–Weinstein Asp6.58 and Glu7.39). This is a construct artifact of the cryo-EM N-terminal truncation in 8U4P. Apply UniProt P61073 numbering for any downstream cross-reference. In the residue table below, ASP270/ASP262 and GLU296/GLU288 therefore refer to the same two residues.

limitations.impact: Template fetch fell back to best-effort; A1D bond orders — including the unique Acceptor at GLN200 — are lower-confidence than the VH6 features.
limitations.mitigation: Cross-check 8ZPL features in PyMOL; supply a validated A1D SMILES on re-run.

limitations.impact: The same residue looks non-conserved if numbers are read literally across PDBs.
limitations.mitigation: Map all residue numbers to UniProt P61073 (Asp6.58, Glu7.39).

limitations.impact: Some optional Donor + PosIonizable features (IDs 5/17, 7/18, 9/20) are the same A1D amine atom in dual roles, inflating the optional count.
limitations.mitigation: Treat each coordinate-coincident pair as one ligand atom when scoring.

limitations.impact: Limited chemotype coverage; the query may over-fit polyamine scaffolds.
limitations.mitigation: Incorporate historical IT1t X-ray structures (3ODU, 3OE6/8/9) to add a third chemotype.

limitations.impact: Predictive performance on prospective screens is unmeasured.
limitations.mitigation: Run a retrospective benchmark (source ligands + decoys) and confirm AUC-ROC > random.
